function updateProgress(){const progress=progression.snapshot();document.querySelectorAll('[data-level]').forEach(b=>{const i=+b.dataset.level,locked=!progression.canEnter(i);b.classList.toggle('locked',locked);b.classList.toggle('selected',selected===i);b.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(locked));b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected===i));b.querySelector('.chapter-state').textContent=locked?'尚未解锁':progress.completed[i]?'已通关':'待通关'});const cleared=progress.completed.slice(0,3).filter(Boolean).length;$('chapter-hint').textContent=progress.unlocked[3]?'星穹实验室已解锁 · 50 座测试平台 · 仅起点存档':`实验室解锁：普通模式通关前三关（${cleared}/3）。`;}
function syncGodUI(){const unlocked=progression.snapshot().godUnlocked;document.body.classList.toggle('god-mode',godEnabled);document.querySelectorAll('[data-god-toggle]').forEach(b=>{b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(godEnabled));b.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(!unlocked));b.setAttribute('aria-label',unlocked?`无敌模式：${godEnabled?'开启':'关闭'}`:'无敌模式：通关四张地图后解锁')});document.querySelectorAll('[data-god-status]').forEach(e=>e.textContent=!unlocked?'未解锁':godEnabled?'开启':'关闭');document.querySelectorAll('[data-god-detail]').forEach(e=>e.textContent=unlocked?'无敌 · 自由飞行 · G 随时切换':'普通模式通关全部四张地图后解锁');$('god-badge').classList.toggle('hidden',!godEnabled||mode==='menu');$('down').classList.toggle('hidden',!godEnabled);$('jump').setAttribute('aria-label',godEnabled?'向上飞行':'跳跃');$('jump').querySelector('small').textContent=godEnabled?'上升':'跳跃';$('play-hint').innerHTML=godEnabled?'<span><kbd>W A S D</kbd> 飞行</span><span><kbd>空格</kbd> 上升</span><span><kbd>Shift</kbd> 下降</span><span><kbd>G</kbd> 关闭无敌</span>':'<span><kbd>W A S D</kbd> 移动</span><span><kbd>空格</kbd> 跳跃</span><span>鼠标环视 · 滚轮缩放</span><span><kbd>R</kbd> 回存档点</span>';}

const geo={box:new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1),ball:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,2),cone:new THREE.ConeGeometry(1,1,7),cylinder:new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,9),circle:new THREE.CircleGeometry(1,32)};
const materialCache=new Map();
function mat(color,opts={}){const k=String(color)+JSON.stringify(opts);if(!materialCache.has(k))materialCache.set(k,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.82,...opts}));return materialCache.get(k)}
function basic(color,opts={}){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color,...opts})}
function mesh(g,m,x,y,z,sx=1,sy=sx,sz=sx,parent=stage){const o=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);o.position.set(x,y,z);o.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);o.castShadow=true;o.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(o);return o}
const box=(m,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,parent)=>mesh(geo.box,m,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,parent);
function rand(seed){let n=seed;return()=>{n=(n*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return n/4294967296}}

function quadrant(x,y){const t=atlas.clone();t.repeat.set(.495,.495);t.offset.set(x*.5+.0025,y*.5+.0025);t.needsUpdate=true;t.anisotropy=Math.min(8,renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());return t}
function textPanel(text,color='#b8fff3',bg='#102536',w=512,h=192){const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.fillStyle=bg;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=7;c.strokeRect(10,10,w-20,h-20);c.fillStyle=color;c.font=`700 ${Math.floor(h*.43)}px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText(text,w/2,h/2+3,w-36);const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return basic(0xffffff,{map:t})}
const glowCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');glowCanvas.width=64;glowCanvas.height=64;const gc=glowCanvas.getContext('2d');const grad=gc.createRadialGradient(32,32,1,32,32,31);grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.75)');grad.addColorStop(.2,'rgba(255,255,255,.3)');grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');gc.fillStyle=grad;gc.fillRect(0,0,64,64);const glowTex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(glowCanvas);
function glow(color,x,y,z,size,parent=stage){const o=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:glowTex,color,transparent:true,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));o.position.set(x,y,z);o.scale.setScalar(size);parent.add(o);return o}
function cloneModel(name,x,y,z,s=1,rotation=0){if(!models[name])return null;const m=models[name].clone(true);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.scale.setScalar(s);m.rotation.y=rotation;m.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){o.castShadow=true;o.receiveShadow=true}});stage.add(m);return m}
function batchStaticModel(root){root.updateMatrixWorld(true);const buckets=new Map,oldGeometries=new Set;root.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh)return;const m=o.material;if(Array.isArray(m))return;const g=o.geometry.index?o.geometry.toNonIndexed():o.geometry.clone();g.applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);for(const key of Object.keys(g.attributes))if(!['position','normal'].includes(key))g.deleteAttribute(key);if(!g.attributes.normal)g.computeVertexNormals();if(!buckets.has(m.uuid))buckets.set(m.uuid,{material:m,geometries:[]});buckets.get(m.uuid).geometries.push(g);oldGeometries.add(o.geometry)});const out=new THREE.Group();for(const b of buckets.values()){const merged=mergeGeometries(b.geometries,false);const item=new THREE.Mesh(merged,b.material);out.add(item);for(const g of b.geometries)g.dispose()}for(const g of oldGeometries)g.dispose();return out}
function makeTree(x,y,z,s=1){const t=new THREE.Group();t.position.set(x,y,z);t.scale.setScalar(s);stage.add(t);mesh(geo.cylinder,mat(0x8a7350),0,1.5,0,.3,3,.3,t);const palette=[0x87a868,0x668f60,0x9ab677];for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const o=mesh(geo.ball,mat(palette[i]),(i-1)*.55,3+i*.5,0,1.6-i*.13,1.3,1.5,t);o.rotation.y=i}return t}
function makePine(x,y,z,s=1){mesh(geo.cylinder,mat(0x78785b),x,y+1.5*s,z,.18*s,3*s,.18*s);for(let j=0;j<2;j++)mesh(geo.cone,mat(j?0x709275:0x53755e),x,y+(2.5+j*1.3)*s,z,1.6*s,(3-j*.5)*s,1.6*s)}
function forestScatter(){const n=400,stem=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo.cylinder,mat(0xe7d6b2),n),caps=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo.ball,mat(0xcb7b59),n),dummy=new THREE.Object3D();let idx=0;for(const p of world.platforms.filter(p=>p.kind!=='rotating')){const count=Math.floor(p.w*p.d*.32);for(let j=0;j<count&&idx<n;j++){const side=random()<.5?-1:1,x=p.x+side*(p.w/2-.3-random()*.6),z=p.z+(random()-.5)*p.d*.9,y=p.y;dummy.position.set(x,y+.11,z);dummy.scale.set(.05,.22,.05);dummy.updateMatrix();stem.setMatrixAt(idx,dummy.matrix);dummy.position.y=y+.25;dummy.scale.set(.18,.1,.18);dummy.updateMatrix();caps.setMatrixAt(idx,dummy.matrix);idx++}}stem.count=caps.count=idx;stem.castShadow=caps.castShadow=true;stage.add(stem,caps);
 const flowers=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo.ball,mat(0xffe9a6),world.platforms.length*22);idx=0;for(const p of world.platforms.filter(p=>p.kind!=='rotating')){for(let j=0;j<22;j++){const x=p.x+(random()<.5?-1:1)*(p.w*.5-.3-random()*.65),z=p.z+(random()-.5)*p.d*.9;dummy.position.set(x,p.y+.09,z);dummy.scale.set(.065,.07,.065);dummy.updateMatrix();flowers.setMatrixAt(idx++,dummy.matrix)}}flowers.count=idx;stage.add(flowers);
}
function createSky(night){const sg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(220,24,16);const sm=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({side:THREE.BackSide,depthWrite:false,uniforms:{top:{value:new THREE.Color(night?0x090d29:0x90c4c5)},bottom:{value:new THREE.Color(night?0x49557d:0xe7edc9)}},vertexShader:'varying vec3 vP; void main(){vP=position;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);}',fragmentShader:'varying vec3 vP;uniform vec3 top;uniform vec3 bottom;void main(){float h=clamp(normalize(vP).y*.9+.13,0.,1.);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(bottom,top,h),1.);}'});sky=new THREE.Mesh(sg,sm);stage.add(sky);const moon=mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(night?6:7,24,16),basic(night?0xd6e8f7:0xfff3c6),night?-46:-50,night?42:46,-100);moon.castShadow=false;glow(night?0xaacaff:0xffefae,moon.position.x,moon.position.y,moon.position.z,night?26:32);if(night){const pos=[];for(let i=0;i<330;i++)pos.push((random()-.5)*220,30+random()*90,-40-random()*120);const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));stage.add(new THREE.Points(g,new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0xb5c2e0,size:.16,transparent:true,opacity:.8})))}}

 for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const z=-i*17;box(mat(0x273d54),-16,6+random()*3,z,16,.5,3);box(basic(0x6ba7d7),-16,6.35,z,16,.05,3.1)}createParticles(true);

function createParticles(night){const pos=[],n=night?650:140;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)pos.push((random()-.5)*75,random()*27-3,20-random()*(night?265:-world.platforms.at(-1).z+65));const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));rain=new THREE.Points(g,new THREE.PointsMaterial({map:night?null:glowTex,color:night?0x9ecae9:0xffefb2,size:night?.075:.28,transparent:true,opacity:night?.38:.8,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));rain.userData.night=night;stage.add(rain)}
function createPlatform(p,night){const g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(p.x,p.y,p.z);stage.add(g);const palace=!!world.def.sky,lab=!!world.def.lab;const sides=lab?mat(0x37576a,{metalness:.6}):palace?mat(0xf6dfdf):night?mat(0x344159,{map:metal,metalness:.5}):mat(0xb1aa83,{map:rock});const top=lab?mat(p.kind==='crumble'?0xd5b997:0xc9e4e7,{roughness:.35,metalness:.45}):palace?mat(p.kind==='crumble'?0xf2d3d5:0xfff3e3,{roughness:.52}):night?mat(p.kind==='crumble'?0xa994b6:0xb3cdd6,{map:metal,roughness:.65,metalness:.18,emissive:0x4a7790,emissiveMap:metal,emissiveIntensity:.42}):mat(0xd2dda7,{map:moss});const slab=box(lab?top:[sides,sides,top,sides,sides,sides],0,-.34,0,p.w,.68,p.d,g);occluders.push(slab);g.userData.slab=slab;
 if(lab)decorateLabPlatform(g,p,{box,mesh,geo,mat,basic});
 else if(palace)decoratePalacePlatform(g,p,{box,mesh,geo,mat,basic});
 else if(night){const c=p.kind==='crumble'?0xfab0d6:p.kind==='moving'?0xf4bf7d:0x85e6df;for(const x of [-p.w/2,p.w/2])box(basic(c),x,-.14,0,.06,.08,p.d,g);for(const z of [-p.d/2,p.d/2])box(basic(c),0,-.14,z,p.w,.08,.06,g);box(mat(0x202c41),0,-.9,0,p.w*.7,.5,p.d*.7,g);if(p.id%3===0)box(mat(0x2d3d54,{map:facade}),0,-8,0,p.w*.8,14,p.d*.8,g);else{const ring=mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.6,.04,6,24),basic(c),0,-1.2,0,1,1,1,g);ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;glow(c,0,-1,0,2,g)}if(p.kind==='laser'){for(const x of [-p.w/2,p.w/2]){box(mat(0x304253),x,.65,0,.25,1.3,.3,g);glow(0xff5380,x,.6,0,1.2,g)}const laser=box(basic(0xff4278),0,.65,0,p.w,.085,.1,g);const halo=box(basic(0xff3c74,{transparent:true,opacity:.15,depthWrite:false}),0,.65,0,p.w,.5,.2,g);g.userData.laser=[laser,halo];}}
 else{box(mat(0x78965c),0,-.05,0,p.w+.09,.13,p.d+.09,g);box(top,0,.022,0,p.w,.03,p.d,g);const underside=mesh(geo.cone,mat(0x897c60,{map:rock}),0,-1.8,0,p.w*.61,3,p.d*.61,g);underside.rotation.z=Math.PI;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const vine=box(mat(0x5b8253),p.w/2-.1,-.7-i*.17,(i-1)*p.d*.25,.09,1.1+i*.5,.1,g);vine.rotation.z=.2*(i-1)}}
 if(night||palace||lab)addMechanismVisual(g,p);
 if(p.kind==='rotating'&&!palace&&!lab){
  g.rotation.y=p.angle;
  // Warm timber and an arrow make the turning deck readable from above.
  for(const z of [-1.1,-.55,0,.55,1.1])box(mat(0xb69a68),0,.055,z,p.w-.8,.035,.44,g);
  for(const z of [-p.d/2+.12,p.d/2-.12])box(mat(0xe8c886,{emissive:0xa98739,emissiveIntensity:.15}),0,.065,z,p.w-.2,.065,.12,g);
  const ring=mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.85,.045,6,36),mat(0xffdda0),0,.12,0,1,1,1,g);ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
  const arrow=mesh(geo.cone,mat(0xffdda0),.85,.13,0,.15,.4,.15,g);arrow.rotation.x=(p.direction||1)*Math.PI/2;
  mesh(geo.cylinder,mat(0xc6b180),0,-1,0,.6,1.3,.6,g);
  const flowers=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo.ball,mat(0xffe5a6),16),dummy=new THREE.Object3D();
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){dummy.position.set((i%2?1:-1)*(p.w/2-.26),.13,-p.d*.4+Math.floor(i/2)/7*p.d*.8);dummy.scale.set(.1,.1,.1);dummy.updateMatrix();flowers.setMatrixAt(i,dummy.matrix)}g.add(flowers);
 }
 if(LEVELS[world.level].checkpoints.includes(p.id)||(world.restartFromStart&&p.id===0)){const pole=box(mat(night?0xadcbd1:0xb09970),-p.w/2+.65,.9,0,.08,1.8,.08,g);const flag=box(basic(night?0x76d5cf:0xe2a765),-p.w/2+1.06,1.5,0,.8,.45,.045,g);flags.push({id:p.id,obj:flag});const ring=mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.6,.68,32),basic(night?0x7eeee1:0xffe2a0,{side:THREE.DoubleSide}),0,.06,0,1,1,1,g);ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;}
 for(const item of world.collectibles.filter(c=>c.platform===p.id)){const rare=item.type==='relic',color=rare?(night?0xee91f0:0x89e8dc):(night?0xaeeff3:0xffd36c);const gem=mesh(rare?new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(.4):new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.22),mat(color,{emissive:color,emissiveIntensity:.65,metalness:.25,roughness:.25}),item.x,item.y,item.z,1,rare?1:1.45,1,g);const halo=glow(color,item.x,item.y,item.z,rare?2.4:1.4,g);let ring;if(rare){ring=mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.62,.025,6,32),basic(color),item.x,item.y,item.z,1,1,1,g);ring.rotation.x=Math.PI*.35;}gems.push({id:item.id,item,obj:gem,halo,ring})}
 return g;
}
const mechanismHints={rotating:'自转浮岛 · 站稳后瞄准下一块，靠近边缘起跳',moving:'移动平台 · 看准位置再起跳',crumble:'塌落平台 · 落地后迅速继续跳',laser:'红色光栅 · 等待熄灭或跳过低梁',sweeper:'旋转光臂 · 跳过低杆，别站在轴心',crusher:'下压闸门 · 黄灯预警，升起再通过',pulse:'间歇平台 · 黄灯快离开，红色轮廓请等待'};
function addMechanismVisual(g,p){
 const palace=!!world.def.sky;
 if((palace||world.def.lab)&&p.kind==='laser'){const signal=mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.75,.82,32),basic(0x9ce9e8,{side:THREE.DoubleSide,transparent:true,opacity:.8}),0,.065,0,1,1,1,g);signal.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;g.userData.signal=signal;}
 if((palace||world.def.lab)&&['laser','crumble','moving','rotating'].includes(p.kind)){const words={laser:'光栅 · 等待',crumble:'限时 · 快跳',moving:'浮台 · 看准',rotating:'转台 · 瞄准'};const label=box(textPanel(words[p.kind],palace?'#6e4560':'#a8fff4',palace?'#fff0dc':'#102536'),0,.22,p.d/2-.11,p.w*.74,.34,.06,g);label.castShadow=false;}
 if(['sweeper','crusher','pulse'].includes(p.kind)){
  const color=p.kind==='sweeper'?0xffa87b:p.kind==='crusher'?0xf28cbd:0x9edfff;
  const label=box(textPanel(p.kind==='sweeper'?'旋转 · 跃过':p.kind==='crusher'?'闸门 · 等待':'间歇 · 看灯',palace?'#75485f':'#b8fff3',palace?'#fff0dc':'#102536'),0,.3,p.d/2-.14,p.w*.76,.42,.08,g);label.castShadow=false;
  const signal=mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.75,.82,32),basic(color,{side:THREE.DoubleSide,transparent:true,opacity:.7}),0,.065,0,1,1,1,g);signal.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;g.userData.signal=signal;
 }
 if(p.kind==='sweeper'){
  const arm=new THREE.Group();arm.position.y=.65;g.add(arm);
  box(mat(palace?0xd9ab57:0x294054,{metalness:.6}),0,0,0,Math.min(p.w,p.d)*.6,.14,.17,arm);
  box(basic(0xffa277),0,.075,0,Math.min(p.w,p.d)*.6,.035,.19,arm);
  mesh(geo.cylinder,mat(palace?0xffe3ca:0x51718a),0,.28,0,.24,.56,.24,g);
  g.userData.arm=arm;
 }
 if(p.kind==='crusher'){
  for(const x of [-1.65,1.65]){box(mat(palace?0xffedda:0x435a77,{metalness:.6}),x,2.2,0,.16,4.4,.22,g);box(basic(0xbc90e7),x,2.3,.13,.06,4,.04,g)}
  box(mat(palace?0xdbad5c:0x354d68),0,4.3,0,3.5,.28,2.2,g);
  const press=new THREE.Group();g.add(press);box(mat(palace?0xdb87ad:0x593f64,{metalness:.65}),0,.325,0,2.1,.65,1.8,press);box(basic(0xff91b5),0,.03,0,2.15,.055,1.85,press);
  for(const x of [-.7,0,.7]){const stripe=box(basic(0xffd078),x,.67,0,.17,.025,1.7,press);stripe.rotation.y=.3}
  g.userData.press=press;
 }
 if(p.kind==='pulse'){
  const ghost=new THREE.Group();ghost.position.copy(g.position);stage.add(ghost);
  for(const x of [-p.w/2,p.w/2])box(basic(0xff6797,{transparent:true,opacity:.6}),x,.03,0,.04,.04,p.d,ghost);
  for(const z of [-p.d/2,p.d/2])box(basic(0xff6797,{transparent:true,opacity:.6}),0,.03,z,p.w,.04,.04,ghost);
  const mark=mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.65,.72,24),basic(0xff6797,{side:THREE.DoubleSide,transparent:true,opacity:.5}),0,.06,0,1,1,1,ghost);mark.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
  g.userData.ghost=ghost;
 }
 updateMechanismVisual(g,p);
}
function updateMechanismVisual(o,a){
 o.userData.slab.layers.set(a.gone?1:0);
 if(o.userData.arm)o.userData.arm.rotation.y=-a.angle;
 if(o.userData.press)o.userData.press.position.y=a.pressY;
 if(o.userData.ghost)o.userData.ghost.visible=a.gone;
 if(o.userData.signal)o.userData.signal.material.color.set(a.warning?0xffc571:((a.kind==='crusher'&&a.pressY<1.6)||(a.kind==='laser'&&a.laserOn))?0xff648e:0x9ce9e8);
}
function createGate(){const p=world.platforms.at(-1),g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(p.x,p.y,p.z-1.5);stage.add(g);const c=world.def.sky?0xffb8d3:world.level?0x92e6ee:0xffe3a0;const ring=mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.65,.13,10,64),mat(world.level?0x86d3dc:0xbeaa7e,{emissive:c,emissiveIntensity:.7}),0,1.8,0,1,1,1,g);const portal=mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.5,48),basic(c,{transparent:true,opacity:.13,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false}),0,1.8,0,1,1,1,g);glow(c,0,1.8,0,5,g);for(const x of [-1.65,1.65])box(mat(world.level?0x465b77:0xa4a080),x,.5,0,.5,1,.65,g);g.userData.ring=ring;g.userData.portal=portal;return g}
function clearStage(){if(!stage)return;scene.remove(stage);const retained=new Set(Object.values(geo));const gm=new Set(),mm=new Set();stage.traverse(o=>{if(o.geometry&&!retained.has(o.geometry))gm.add(o.geometry);if(o.material){for(const m of Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])mm.add(m)}});const modelGeo=new Set(),modelMat=new Set();for(const m of Object.values(models))m.traverse(o=>{if(o.geometry)modelGeo.add(o.geometry);if(o.material)for(const x of Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])modelMat.add(x)});for(const g of gm)if(!modelGeo.has(g))g.dispose();for(const m of mm)if(!modelMat.has(m)&&![...materialCache.values()].includes(m)){if(m.map&&m.map!==atlas&&m.map!==glowTex&&![moss,rock,metal,facade].includes(m.map))m.map.dispose();m.dispose()}}
function buildLevel(level){clearStage();world=new GameWorld(level);world.setGodMode(godEnabled);world.setCharacter(PLAYER_PROFILE);mixedCharacters=false;random=rand(level?61:24);stage=new THREE.Group();scene.add(stage);playerVisual=null;platformVisuals=[];gems=[];flags=[];movers=[];occluders=[];bursts=[];rain=null;water=null;sky=null;document.body.classList.toggle('night',level===1);document.body.classList.toggle('palace',!!world.def.sky);document.body.classList.toggle('laboratory',!!world.def.lab);platformVisuals=world.platforms.map(p=>createPlatform(p,level===1));if(world.def.lab)buildLab(world,{stage,scene,hemi,sun,fill});else if(world.def.sky)sky=buildPalace(world,{stage,scene,hemi,sun,fill});else level?buildCity():buildForest();gate=createGate();replacePlayerVisual();camera.position.set(22,20,24);camTarget.set(0,1,-18);camera.lookAt(camTarget);$('hud-index').textContent=`0${level+1}`;$('hud-title').textContent=world.def.name;$('hud-subtitle').textContent=world.def.subtitle;updateHud();updateAlbum();updateProgress();syncGodUI();}
function toast(text,duration=3000){$('toast').textContent=text;$('toast').classList.add('show');toastUntil=performance.now()+duration}
function updateHud(){const stats=world.stats();$('health').textContent=`${world.player.hp} / ${world.player.maxHp} HP`;const here=world.platforms[world.player.on??world.farthest],next=world.platforms[Math.min(here.id+1,world.platforms.length-1)],info=mechanismHints[here.kind]||mechanismHints[next.kind];$('hud-subtitle').textContent=(world.godMode?'自由飞行 · 空格上升 · Shift 下降':info)||(world.def.lab?here.section+' · 仅起点存档':world.def.sky?'高空长途试炼 · 仅起点存档':world.level?'跟着微光前进 · 存档旗保留进度':'长隙需要助跑 · 靠近边缘再起跳');$('crystals').textContent=`${stats.lights} / ${stats.lightMax}`;$('relics').textContent=`${stats.relics} / ${stats.relicMax}`;$('score').textContent=String(stats.score);$('collection-bar').style.width=`${stats.total/stats.maxTotal*100}%`;$('collection-label').textContent=stats.all?'✦ 全收集完成':`${stats.total} / ${stats.maxTotal} 已收集`;$('timer').textContent=formatTime(world.time);$('checkpoint-text').textContent=world.restartFromStart?'唯一起点存档':world.checkpoint?`存档点 ${world.def.checkpoints.indexOf(world.checkpoint)+1}`:'起点';$('progress').style.width=`${world.farthest/(world.platforms.length-1)*100}%`}
function formatTime(t){return `${Math.floor(t/60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}:${Math.floor(t%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}`}
function setSelected(n){if(!progression.canEnter(n)){toast('天宫需要通关森林与都市；实验室需要普通模式通关前三关。',4200);return false}selected=n;$('start').firstElementChild.textContent=['出发，去森林','出发，去都市','出发，去天宫','进入星穹实验室'][n];$('caption-title').textContent=['01 / 林间来信','02 / 霓虹天际','03 / 绯晶天宫','04 / 星穹实验室'][n];$('caption-desc').textContent=['22 座浮岛，5 块自转平台，跨过更远的林间长隙。','30 座平台，6 种机关，跃过整座夜城。','绯晶、金边与云海之间，44 段高空试炼一路通往天宫。','50 座测试平台，完整运作的未来科技实验室。'][n];buildLevel(n);return true}
function begin(level=selected){if(!progression.canEnter(level)){toast('天宫需要通关森林与都市；实验室需要普通模式通关前三关。',4200);return false}resetView(true);selected=level;buildLevel(level);mode='playing';accumulator=0;jumpQueued=false;keys.clear();touch.x=touch.z=0;touch.jump=touch.down=false;document.body.classList.add('playing');for(const id of ['menu','scene-caption','edition','modal'])$(id).classList.add('hidden');for(const id of ['hud','pause','play-hint','touch-controls','camera-tools'])$(id).classList.remove('hidden');camera.position.set(0,10,18);camTarget.set(0,1,-4);camera.lookAt(camTarget);toast(godEnabled?'自由飞行 · 空格上升 · Shift 下降':matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches?'移动鼠标自由环视，WASD 移动，空格跳跃，Esc 暂停。':'滑动空白处环视，收集微光和珍藏。',5200);ensureAudio();syncGodUI();enterImmersive();return true;}
function home(){if(mode==='playing'||mode==='paused')saveNow();cameraPointers.clear();mode='menu';releaseMouse();releaseKeyboard();if(document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});keys.clear();touch.x=touch.z=0;touch.jump=touch.down=false;document.body.classList.remove('playing');for(const id of ['menu','scene-caption','edition'])$(id).classList.remove('hidden');for(const id of ['hud','pause','play-hint','touch-controls','camera-tools','modal'])$(id).classList.add('hidden');$('toast').classList.remove('show');setSelected(selected)}
function pauseGame(){if(mode!=='playing')return;mode='paused';releaseMouse();cameraPointers.clear();jumpQueued=false;keys.clear();touch.x=touch.z=0;touch.jump=touch.down=false;showModal('TAKE A BREATH','歇一小会儿','风景会在这里等你。','继续冒险',false)}
function resume(){if(mode!=='paused')return false;mode='playing';accumulator=0;jumpQueued=false;keys.clear();$('modal').classList.add('hidden');syncGodUI();enterImmersive();return true}
export function exportCurrentRun(){
 if(!['playing','paused'].includes(mode)||world.complete)return null;
 return {schema:'mosslight-3d-run',version:1,level:world.level,character:PLAYER_PROFILE,lastNormalCharacter:PLAYER_PROFILE,runCharacter:PLAYER_PROFILE,mixedCharacters,godMode:world.godMode,usedGodMode:world.usedGodMode,time:world.time,attemptTime:world.attemptTime,deaths:world.deaths,falls:world.falls,fallHistory:world.fallHistory.map(q=>({...q})),checkpoint:world.checkpoint,farthest:world.farthest,collected:[...world.collected],player:{...world.player},respawnGrace:world.respawnGrace,jumpHeld:world.jumpHeld,dashTime:world.dashTime,dashDirection:{...world.dashDirection},platforms:world.platforms.map(a=>({id:a.id,x:a.x,dx:a.dx,angle:a.angle??0,dAngle:a.dAngle??0,triggerAt:a.triggerAt,gone:a.gone,laserOn:a.laserOn,warning:!!a.warning,pressY:a.pressY??null})),camera:{...view,target:{...viewTarget}},animTime};
}
export function restoreCurrentRun(record){
 const finite=(n,min=-1e8,max=1e8)=>typeof n==='number'&&Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=min&&n<=max;
 const index=(n,max)=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<max;
 const profile=restorePlayerProfile(record);
 if(!profile||record.schema!=='mosslight-3d-run'||record.version!==1||!progression.canEnter(record.level))return false;
 if(record.godMode&&!progression.snapshot().godUnlocked)return false;
 const candidate=new GameWorld(record.level),count=candidate.platforms.length,b=candidate.flightBounds,p=record.player;
 if(!finite(record.time,0,31536000)||!finite(record.attemptTime,0,record.time+1)||!Number.isInteger(record.deaths)||!finite(record.deaths,0,1e7)||!index(record.farthest,count)||!index(record.checkpoint,count)||record.checkpoint!==0&&!candidate.def.checkpoints.includes(record.checkpoint)||candidate.restartFromStart&&record.checkpoint!==0)return false;
 if(!p||!finite(p.x,b.minX-64,b.maxX+64)||!finite(p.y,-32,b.maxY+32)||!finite(p.z,b.minZ-64,b.maxZ+64)||!['vx','vy','vz'].every(k=>finite(p[k],-128,128))||!finite(p.facing)||!finite(p.coyote,0,1)||!finite(p.buffer,0,1)||typeof p.grounded!=='boolean'||p.on!==null&&!index(p.on,count))return false;
 if(!Number.isInteger(p.hp??6)||(p.hp??6)<1||(p.hp??6)>6||(p.maxHp??6)!==6||record.falls!==undefined&&(!Number.isInteger(record.falls)||record.falls<0||record.falls>1e7)||!candidate.restoreFallHistory(record.fallHistory))return false;
 if(!Array.isArray(record.collected)||record.collected.length>candidate.collectibles.length||!record.collected.every(id=>candidate.collectibles.some(item=>item.id===id)))return false;
 if(!Array.isArray(record.platforms)||record.platforms.length!==count||!record.platforms.every((a,i)=>a&&a.id===i&&finite(a.x,b.minX-64,b.maxX+64)&&finite(a.dx,-64,64)&&finite(a.angle)&&finite(a.dAngle)&&(a.triggerAt===null||finite(a.triggerAt,0,record.attemptTime+1))&&['gone','laserOn','warning'].every(k=>typeof a[k]==='boolean')&&(a.pressY===null||finite(a.pressY,-1,32))))return false;
 const c=record.camera,validView=v=>v&&finite(v.yaw)&&finite(v.pitch,-1.15,1.42)&&finite(v.distance,9,27);
 if(!validView(c)||!validView(c.target)||!finite(record.animTime,0,1e8)||!finite(record.respawnGrace,0,2)||typeof record.jumpHeld!=='boolean'||!finite(record.dashTime,0,.28)||!record.dashDirection||!['x','y','z'].every(k=>finite(record.dashDirection[k],-1,1)))return false;
 mode='paused';releaseMouse();cameraPointers.clear();keys.clear();resetStick();jumpQueued=false;touch.jump=touch.down=false;accumulator=0;
 selected=record.level;godEnabled=!!saveGodMode(storage,record.godMode);
 buildLevel(selected);mixedCharacters=profile.mixedCharacters;
 Object.assign(world,{time:record.time,attemptTime:record.attemptTime,deaths:record.deaths,checkpoint:record.checkpoint,farthest:record.farthest,respawnGrace:record.respawnGrace,jumpHeld:record.jumpHeld,dashTime:0,dashDirection:{x:0,y:0,z:-1},usedGodMode:profile.usedGodMode,complete:false});
 Object.assign(world.player,p,{hp:p.hp??6,maxHp:6});world.falls=record.falls??0;world.restoreFallHistory(record.fallHistory);world.collected=new Set(record.collected);world.events=[];
 record.platforms.forEach((a,i)=>{const target=world.platforms[i];for(const key of ['x','dx','angle','dAngle','triggerAt','gone','laserOn','warning'])target[key]=a[key];if(a.pressY!==null)target.pressY=a.pressY});
 if(record.fallHistory===undefined)world.rememberFallPoint();
 Object.assign(view,{yaw:c.yaw,pitch:c.pitch,distance:c.distance});Object.assign(viewTarget,c.target);animTime=record.animTime;
 document.body.classList.add('playing');for(const id of ['menu','scene-caption','edition'])$(id).classList.add('hidden');for(const id of ['hud','pause','play-hint','touch-controls','camera-tools'])$(id).classList.remove('hidden');
 animateScene(0);Object.assign(viewTarget,view);updateCamera(0,true);Object.assign(viewTarget,c.target);updateHud();syncGodUI();showModal('JOURNEY RESTORED','接着上次的旅程','白色方块的位置、收集与机关状态已恢复。点击继续冒险。','继续冒险',false);syncKeyboardLock();return true;
}
function showModal(eyebrow,title,text,button,result){$('modal-eyebrow').textContent=eyebrow;$('modal-title').textContent=title;$('modal-text').textContent=text;$('modal-primary').innerHTML=`${button}<b>↗</b>`;$('result-stats').classList.toggle('hidden',!result);$('run-character-name').textContent=PLAYER_NAME;$('modal').classList.remove('hidden');syncGodUI();$('modal-primary').focus()}
function nextChapter(){const progress=progression.snapshot();return [0,1,2,3].find(i=>progression.canEnter(i)&&!progress.completed[i])??-1}
function finish(){clearRun('3d');mode='complete';releaseMouse();releaseKeyboard();cameraPointers.clear();keys.clear();touch.x=touch.z=0;touch.jump=touch.down=false;saveCollection();const credited=progression.complete(world.level,PLAYER_PROFILE,{usedGodMode:world.usedGodMode,mixedCharacters});updateProgress();const stats=world.stats();let best=world.time;if(credited)try{const key=`mosslight-best-normal-${PLAYER_PROFILE}-${world.level}`,old=Number(storage?.getItem(key));best=Math.min(Number.isFinite(old)&&old>0?old:Infinity,world.time);storage?.setItem(key,String(best))}catch{}$('result-stats').innerHTML=`<div>${stats.score}<small>收集积分 / ${stats.maxScore}</small></div><div>${stats.lights}<small>微光 / ${stats.lightMax}</small></div><div>${stats.relics}<small>珍藏 / ${stats.relicMax}</small></div>`;const next=nextChapter(),progress=progression.snapshot(),reason=credited?`已记录${PLAYER_NAME}的普通通关。`:world.usedGodMode?'本轮使用过无敌模式，不计普通通关。':'本轮存档带有混合操作记录，不计普通通关。';showModal(stats.rank,['森林，已在身后。','霓虹，已在身后。','云端天宫，已抵达。','奇点核心，已抵达。'][world.level],`${formatTime(world.time)} · 重试 ${world.deaths} 次。${reason}${progress.godUnlocked?' 无敌模式已解锁！':progress.unlocked[3]?' 星穹实验室现已解锁。':''}`,next<0||!credited?'返回选关':'继续 · '+LEVELS[next].name,true);$('modal-primary').dataset.next=String(credited?next:-1);playTone(784,.2,'sine',.06);setTimeout(()=>playTone(1046,.5,'sine',.05),160)}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-level]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(mode==='menu')setSelected(+b.dataset.level)}));$('start').onclick=()=>begin();$('pause').onclick=pauseGame;$('brand').onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();if(mode==='playing')pauseGame();else home()};$('home').onclick=home;$('restart').onclick=()=>begin(world.level);$('modal-primary').onclick=()=>mode==='paused'?resume():+$('modal-primary').dataset.next<0?home():begin(+$('modal-primary').dataset.next);
document.querySelectorAll('[data-god-toggle]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setGodMode(!godEnabled));
$('fullscreen').onclick=async()=>{try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else{await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();syncKeyboardLock()}}catch{toast('浏览器未开启全屏，可使用窗口最大化。')}};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(mode==='playing'&&['KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','ShiftLeft','ShiftRight'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();if(['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();if(e.code==='KeyG'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setGodMode(!godEnabled);return}if(e.code==='KeyC'&&mode==='playing'){resetView();return}if(e.code==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();if(!e.repeat&&mode==='playing')pauseGame();return}if(e.code==='Space'&&!e.repeat&&mode==='playing')jumpQueued=true;if(e.code==='KeyR'&&mode==='playing'&&!e.repeat){world.respawn();return}keys.add(e.code)});addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys.delete(e.code));addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();if(mode==='playing')pauseGame()});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)pauseGame()});
let stickPointer=null;const stick=$('stick'),joy=$('joystick');function moveStick(e){const r=joy.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2,dy=e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2,radius=r.width*.32,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy),scale=Math.min(1,radius/(len||1));touch.x=dx*scale/radius;touch.z=dy*scale/radius;stick.style.transform=`translate(${dx*scale}px,${dy*scale}px)`}joy.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{stickPointer=e.pointerId;joy.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);moveStick(e)});joy.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId===stickPointer)moveStick(e)});function resetStick(){stickPointer=null;touch.x=touch.z=0;stick.style.transform=''}joy.addEventListener('pointerup',resetStick);joy.addEventListener('pointercancel',resetStick);joy.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',resetStick);$('jump').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();$('jump').setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);touch.jump=true;jumpQueued=true});for(const e of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])$('jump').addEventListener(e,()=>touch.jump=false);
$('down').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();$('down').setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);touch.down=true});for(const e of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])$('down').addEventListener(e,()=>touch.down=false);
const canvas=renderer.domElement;
function releaseMouse(){if(document.pointerLockElement)document.exitPointerLock();document.body.classList.remove('mouse-locked')}
function releaseKeyboard(){keyboardLockEpoch++;try{navigator.keyboard?.unlock?.()}catch{}keyboardLockState='idle'}
function syncKeyboardLock(){
 if(!document.fullscreenElement||!['playing','paused'].includes(mode)){releaseKeyboard();return}
 if(!navigator.keyboard?.lock){keyboardLockState='unsupported';return}
 if(keyboardLockState==='locked'||keyboardLockState==='locking')return;
 const epoch=++keyboardLockEpoch;keyboardLockState='locking';
 // Only Escape is captured. Browsers retain their own long-press exit gesture.
 try{navigator.keyboard.lock(['Escape']).then(()=>{if(epoch!==keyboardLockEpoch)return;if(!document.fullscreenElement||!['playing','paused'].includes(mode)){releaseKeyboard();return}keyboardLockState='locked'},()=>{if(epoch===keyboardLockEpoch)keyboardLockState='unavailable'})}catch{keyboardLockState='unavailable'}
}
function enterImmersive(){if(mode!=='playing'||!matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches)return;
 // Pointer lock is requested before fullscreen so both use the same click gesture.
 if(document.pointerLockElement!==canvas&&canvas.requestPointerLock){try{const lock=canvas.requestPointerLock();if(lock?.catch)lock.catch(()=>{if(mode==='playing')toast('点击画面启用鼠标环视，Esc 可随时暂停。',3000)})}catch{toast('点击画面启用鼠标环视。',2000)}}
 if(!document.fullscreenElement&&document.documentElement.requestFullscreen){try{const fs=document.documentElement.requestFullscreen({navigationUI:'hide'});fs?.then(()=>{if(mode==='menu'){document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});return}syncKeyboardLock()}).catch(()=>{if(mode==='playing')toast('点击右上角全屏按钮，或继续在窗口中游玩。',3000)})}catch{}}else syncKeyboardLock();
}
$('mouse-capture').onclick=enterImmersive;
document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange',()=>{const locked=document.pointerLockElement===canvas;if(locked&&mode!=='playing'){wasPointerLocked=true;releaseMouse();return}document.body.classList.toggle('mouse-locked',locked);$('mouse-capture').textContent=locked?'鼠标已锁定':'启用鼠标环视';if(wasPointerLocked&&!locked&&mode==='playing')pauseGame();wasPointerLocked=locked});
document.addEventListener('pointerlockerror',()=>{if(mode==='playing')toast('点击画面重新启用鼠标环视，Esc 可释放鼠标。',3000)});
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(mode==='playing'&&document.pointerLockElement===canvas)mouseLook(viewTarget,e.movementX,e.movementY)});
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{const fullscreen=!!document.fullscreenElement;if(wasFullscreen&&!fullscreen&&mode==='playing')pauseGame();wasFullscreen=fullscreen;syncKeyboardLock();$('fullscreen').setAttribute('aria-label',fullscreen?'退出全屏':'全屏');$('fullscreen').title=fullscreen?'退出全屏':'全屏'});
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(mode!=='playing'||(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0&&e.button!==2))return;if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&canvas.requestPointerLock){if(document.pointerLockElement!==canvas)enterImmersive();return}e.preventDefault();canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);cameraPointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});if(cameraPointers.size===2){const [a,b]=[...cameraPointers.values()];pinchDistance=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)}});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(document.pointerLockElement===canvas)return;const prior=cameraPointers.get(e.pointerId);if(!prior||mode!=='playing')return;const dx=e.clientX-prior.x,dy=e.clientY-prior.y;prior.x=e.clientX;prior.y=e.clientY;if(cameraPointers.size===2){const [a,b]=[...cameraPointers.values()],distance=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);if(pinchDistance>0)orbitZoom(viewTarget,(pinchDistance-distance)*2.2);pinchDistance=distance}else orbitDrag(viewTarget,dx,dy)});
for(const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])canvas.addEventListener(type,e=>{cameraPointers.delete(e.pointerId);pinchDistance=0});
canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(mode!=='playing')return;e.preventDefault();orbitZoom(viewTarget,e.deltaY)},{passive:false});
$('camera-reset').onclick=()=>resetView();
function updateCamera(dt,snap=false){
 const p=world.player,blend=snap?1:1-Math.exp(-dt*14);
 view.yaw+=(viewTarget.yaw-view.yaw)*blend;
 view.pitch+=(viewTarget.pitch-view.pitch)*blend;
 view.distance+=(viewTarget.distance-view.distance)*blend;
 const sy=Math.sin(view.yaw),cy=Math.cos(view.yaw),height=world.godMode?p.y:Math.max(p.y,world.platforms[world.checkpoint].y-1);
 // Keep the pivot at the character when looking up, so ground collision cannot push the camera inside it.
 const ahead=2.8*clamp(view.pitch/.5,0,1);
 temp.set(p.x-sy*ahead,height+1.15,p.z-cy*ahead);
 camTarget.lerp(temp,snap?1:1-Math.exp(-dt*12));
 desiredCam.set(p.x+sy*Math.cos(view.pitch)*view.distance,height+1.15+Math.sin(view.pitch)*view.distance,p.z+cy*Math.cos(view.pitch)*view.distance);
 sightDirection.copy(desiredCam).sub(camTarget);
 const distance=sightDirection.length();sightDirection.normalize();
 sightRay.set(camTarget,sightDirection);sightRay.far=distance;
 const hit=sightRay.intersectObjects(occluders,false)[0];
 if(hit)desiredCam.copy(camTarget).addScaledVector(sightDirection,Math.max(.02,hit.distance-.3));
 camera.position.lerp(desiredCam,snap||hit?1:1-Math.exp(-dt*14));
 camera.lookAt(camTarget);
 // Hide only at very close range, as in a third-person camera pressed against a wall.
 if(playerVisual){temp.set(p.x,p.y+.85,p.z);playerVisual.visible=camera.position.distanceToSquared(temp)>2.25}
}
function pickupBurst(e){const group=new THREE.Group();group.position.set(e.x,e.y,e.z);const rare=e.item.type==='relic';for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const particle=mesh(geo.ball,basic(rare?0x9ffff0:0xffdc77,{transparent:true,opacity:.9}),0,0,0,.065,.065,.065,group);const angle=i/12*Math.PI*2;particle.userData.velocity=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(angle)*(1+Math.random()),1+Math.random()*2,Math.sin(angle)*(1+Math.random()));particle.castShadow=false}stage.add(group);bursts.push({group,life:.75})}

let ac,master,lastNote=0,musicStep=0;function ensureAudio(){if(!audioOn)return;try{ac??=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();master??=(()=>{const n=ac.createGain();n.gain.value=.32;n.connect(ac.destination);return n})();if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume()}catch{audioOn=false;toast('声音暂不可用')}}function playTone(freq,dur=.2,type='sine',volume=.1){if(!audioOn||!ac||!master||ac.state!=='running')return;const o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,ac.currentTime);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume,ac.currentTime+.012);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ac.currentTime+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(master);o.start();o.stop(ac.currentTime+dur+.05);o.onended=()=>{o.disconnect();g.disconnect()}}
$('sound').onclick=()=>{audioOn=!audioOn;$('sound').querySelector('.slash').style.display=audioOn?'none':'';$('sound').setAttribute('aria-label',audioOn?'关闭声音':'开启声音');$('sound').title=audioOn?'关闭声音':'开启声音';ensureAudio();if(master)master.gain.setTargetAtTime(audioOn?.32:0,ac.currentTime,.05);if(audioOn)playTone(523,.3,'sine',.12)};
function updateAudio(now){if(mode!=='playing'||!audioOn)return;const interval=world.level?.31:.55;if(now-lastNote>interval){lastNote=now;const notes=world.level?[220,329.63,440,293.66,220,392,329.63,493.88]:[261.63,329.63,392,523.25,440,392,329.63,293.66];playTone(notes[musicStep++%notes.length],world.level?.28:.9,world.level?'triangle':'sine',world.level?.042:.065);if(musicStep%8===0)playTone(world.level?110:130.8,2.8,'sine',.045)}}
function processEvents(){for(const e of world.drain()){if(e.type==='dash')playTone(250,.14,'triangle',.08);if(e.type==='jump')playTone(world.level?480:580,.12,'sine',.06);if(e.type==='pickup'){playTone(e.item.type==='relic'?1318:1046,.3,'sine',.12);pickupBurst(e);saveCollection();$('collection-stats').animate([{transform:'scale(1.07)'},{transform:'scale(1)'}],{duration:280});toast(`${e.item.name} +${e.item.points} · ${world.stats().total} / ${world.stats().maxTotal}`,1600)}if(e.type==='allCollected'){rewardHalo.visible=true;toast('全收集完成！金色光环已解锁，下次冒险也会保留。',4200)}if(e.type==='checkpoint'){dispatchEvent(new Event('mosslight-checkpoint'));playTone(660,.4,'sine',.12);toast('存档点已点亮，已收集物品不会丢失。',2400)}if(e.type==='fallRecovered'){playTone(220,.18,'triangle',.07);toast(`坠落 −2 HP · 返回安全落脚点 · 剩余 ${e.hp} / 6`,2800);updateCamera(0,true);dispatchEvent(new Event('mosslight-checkpoint'))}if(e.type==='respawn'){playTone(160,.2,'triangle',.08);toast(world.restartFromStart?world.def.name+'挑战重新开始，返回唯一起点存档。':'再跳一次，藏品和积分都还在。',1800);updateCamera(0,true)}if(e.type==='crumble')toast('平台正在松动，继续向前！',1600);if(e.type==='complete')finish()}}
function animateScene(dt){const t=animTime,p=world.player;for(let i=0;i<platformVisuals.length;i++){const a=world.platforms[i],o=platformVisuals[i];o.position.x=a.x;o.rotation.y=a.kind==='rotating'?a.angle:0;o.visible=!a.gone;if(a.kind==='crumble'&&a.triggerAt!==null&&!a.gone){o.position.x+=Math.sin(t*70)*.035;o.position.y=a.y+Math.sin(t*60)*.02}else o.position.y=a.y;if(o.userData.laser){const on=a.laserOn;for(const l of o.userData.laser)l.visible=on;}updateMechanismVisual(o,a);}
 for(const gem of gems){const visible=!world.collected.has(gem.id);gem.obj.visible=gem.halo.visible=visible;if(gem.ring){gem.ring.visible=visible;gem.ring.rotation.z=t*.9}gem.obj.rotation.y=t*(gem.item.type==='relic'?1:1.6);gem.obj.position.y=gem.item.y+Math.sin(t*2.3+gem.item.platform)*.1;gem.halo.position.y=gem.obj.position.y}
 for(let i=bursts.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=bursts[i];b.life-=dt;for(const part of b.group.children){part.position.addScaledVector(part.userData.velocity,dt);part.userData.velocity.y-=dt*4;part.material.opacity=Math.max(0,b.life/.75)}if(b.life<=0){stage.remove(b.group);for(const part of b.group.children)part.material.dispose();bursts.splice(i,1)}}
 for(const f of flags)f.obj.material.color.set(f.id<=world.checkpoint?(world.level?0xafffee:0xcdf28e):(world.level?0x76d5cf:0xe2a765));for(const m of movers){if(m.type==='cloud')m.obj.position.x=m.base+Math.sin(t*.025)*8;if(m.type==='car')m.obj.position.x=((m.base+t*m.speed+65)%130)-65;if(m.type==='water')m.obj.position.y=-2-((t*3+m.base+20)%8)}
 if(rain){const a=rain.geometry.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<a.count;i++){if(rain.userData.night){a.array[i*3+1]-=dt*8;if(a.array[i*3+1]<-5)a.array[i*3+1]=25}else{a.array[i*3]+=Math.sin(t+i)*dt*.12;a.array[i*3+1]+=Math.cos(t*.6+i)*dt*.1}}a.needsUpdate=true}
 if(gate){gate.userData.portal.material.opacity=.1+Math.sin(t*2)*.04;gate.userData.ring.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*.5)*.06}
 if(playerVisual){playerVisual.position.set(p.x,p.y+.035,p.z);const running=Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vz);const targetRot=mode==='menu'?Math.PI*.18:p.facing;let delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(targetRot-playerVisual.rotation.y),Math.cos(targetRot-playerVisual.rotation.y));playerVisual.rotation.y+=delta*Math.min(1,dt*12);playerVisual.rotation.z=0;playerVisual.rotation.x=0;const bob=mode==='playing'&&p.grounded?Math.sin(t*16)*Math.min(running,.7)*.025:0;playerVisual.position.y+=bob;playerVisual.scale.y=p.grounded?1+Math.sin(t*3)*.006:1.035;const s=playerVisual.userData.shadow;const ground=world.platforms.find(a=>!a.gone&&platformContains(a,p.x,p.z));s.visible=!!ground;if(ground){s.position.set(p.x,ground.y+.052,p.z);s.material.opacity=.2/(1+Math.max(0,p.y-ground.y)*.65);s.scale.setScalar(.58+Math.max(0,p.y-ground.y)*.035)}}
}
function frame(ms){requestAnimationFrame(frame);const dt=Math.min((ms-last)/1000||.016,.05);last=ms;if(mode==='playing'||mode==='menu')animTime+=dt;if(mode==='playing'){viewTarget.yaw+=((keys.has('KeyE')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyQ')?1:0))*dt*1.5;updateCamera(dt);accumulator+=dt;const input={x:(keys.has('KeyD')||keys.has('ArrowRight')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyA')||keys.has('ArrowLeft')?1:0)+touch.x,z:(keys.has('KeyS')||keys.has('ArrowDown')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyW')||keys.has('ArrowUp')?1:0)+touch.z,y:(keys.has('Space')||touch.jump?1:0)-(keys.has('ShiftLeft')||keys.has('ShiftRight')||touch.down?1:0),jump:keys.has('Space')||touch.jump||jumpQueued};const relative=cameraRelative(input.x,input.z,view.yaw);input.x=relative.x;input.z=relative.z;while(accumulator>=1/120&&mode==='playing'){world.step(1/120,input);jumpQueued=false;processEvents();accumulator-=1/120}updateHud();const p=world.player;sun.position.set(p.x-24,40+(world.restartFromStart?p.y:0),p.z+10);sun.target.position.set(p.x,world.restartFromStart?p.y:0,p.z-7);sun.target.updateMatrixWorld();}
 else if(mode==='menu'){const narrow=innerWidth<600;desiredCam.set(narrow?15:21+Math.sin(animTime*.13)*1.5,narrow?19:21,narrow?23:23);if(world.def.lab)desiredCam.set(narrow?11:15,10,16);camera.position.lerp(desiredCam,.035);camTarget.set(narrow?0:-5,narrow?1:0,narrow?-9:-16);camera.lookAt(camTarget)}
 if(mode!=='paused')animateScene(dt);updateAudio(ms/1000);if(ms>toastUntil)$('toast').classList.remove('show');if(sky)sky.position.set(camera.position.x,0,camera.position.z);renderer.render(scene,camera)}
function resize(){renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);camera.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;camera.fov=innerWidth<600?60:49;camera.updateProjectionMatrix()}addEventListener('resize',resize);
async function init(){try{atlas=await new THREE.TextureLoader().loadAsync('./assets/world-atlas.png');atlas.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;moss=quadrant(0,1);rock=quadrant(1,1);metal=quadrant(0,0);facade=quadrant(1,0);const loader=new GLTFLoader();await Promise.all(['player','forest_cottage','forest_tree','city_kiosk'].map(async name=>{try{models[name]=batchStaticModel((await loader.loadAsync(`./assets/models/${name}.glb`)).scene)}catch(e){console.warn('Model fallback',name)}}));buildLevel(0);resize();$('loading').classList.add('hidden');requestAnimationFrame(frame);return true}catch(e){console.error(e);$('loading-text').textContent='场景加载失败，请刷新后重试。'}}
